

=== Introduction To the Course ===


--- Welcome ---

Hi everyone.
Welcome to the genetic AI and generative AI bootcamp with Landgraf and Lankin.
I am Krishna and I will be your instructor throughout this exciting journey into the world of AI agents
and cutting edge generative AI applications.
In this course, you will not only understand the theoretical concepts behind Agentic AI, but also
gain hands on experience by building real world applications using the most in-demand tools like Lang
Lang, graph, Lang Smith, OpenAI, grok, Lama, and many more.
We will start by setting up your development environments with Anaconda and VSCode, and get you started
with essential tools like Pydantic and Python.
You will then dive into Lang with a practical, project based approach, learning how to interact with
models like OpenAI and llama, and build foundational application using LCL.
As we progress, you will learn to build AI agents with memory and conversation history, explore the
differences between traditional agents and agentic system, and start building your own autonomous workflows.
A major part of this course is focused on Landgraf, where you will not only understand its core concepts
and components, but also implement advanced workflows, integrate human in the loop mechanism, and
build rack based applications.
You will also learn to debug your application efficiently using Lang Smith, ensuring your projects
are production ready.
Whether you are a data scientist, AI engineers, or someone deeply passionate about building intelligent
application with AI, this course is structured to take you from beginner to the expert level with hands
on code walkthroughs, real world use cases, and system design best practices.
So what are you waiting for?
Go ahead and enroll now and I will see you all in the class.
Thank you.

So values basically means it will stream the full state of the graph whenever a graph basically executes
whatever is saved in the state.
